notes: Test-touch labels are a LOWER BOUND on relevant tests: a human may touch fewer tests than a change could break. High recall here is necessary, not sufficient proof of coverage.

Commit messages are written AFTER the work and often name the very files or behaviour that changed. A Forge task prompt is written before. These scores are therefore an UPPER BOUND on live performance.
Co-change labels encode one team's testing habits and repo layout. Numbers from this repo do not transfer to another repo without re-measuring there.
